Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Maciej Kosiedowski
Message:
Harden the package and add the CI, security and release tooling

Public-release review of the package, with the findings applied.

Correctness

* SubmitJob now drops queued URLs that do not belong to the configured host.
  Previously IndexNowService accepted any URL, SubmitJob let the resulting
  InvalidConfigException escape, and the offending URL stayed in the store —
  so one foreign URL made every future run fail forever.
* SubmitJob chunks the queue at 10 000 URLs, the limit the IndexNow
  specification puts on a single submission. The batch size is configurable.
* Host and Url::host() normalise the optional fully qualified trailing dot, so
  a host configured as "example.com." no longer rejects every URL.
* IndexNowConfig rejects duplicate engine names instead of silently keeping the
  last one; SearchEngine rejects an empty name.
* Response bodies echoed into SubmitFailedException are whitespace-collapsed and
  truncated to 500 characters; the endpoint, status code and full body are now
  exposed as properties.
* HttpIndexNowClient takes a configurable User-Agent.
* phpunit.xml.dist no longer requests a coverage report unconditionally — the
  suite reported "No tests executed" on machines without pcov/xdebug.

Quality gates

The README claimed 100% line and mutation coverage; the actual numbers were
99.29% and 94.55%. Both are now genuinely 100% and enforced in CI, together with
PHPStan level 10 and a PSR-12 coding standard.

* CI workflow: coding standards, static analysis, PHP 8.2-8.5 test matrix
  against lowest and highest dependencies, mutation testing, coverage gate.
* Security workflow: composer audit on a weekly schedule, dependency review.
* Dependabot for composer and github-actions.
* Dev tooling modernised: PHPUnit 11-13, PHPStan 2, Infection 0.29/0.35,
  PHP-CS-Fixer. Minimum PHP is now 8.2 (8.1 is end of life).

Packaging and community files

composer.json gains homepage, support and suggest metadata; the repository gains
CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, SECURITY, an .editorconfig, issue and
pull request templates, and an accurate README and CLAUDE.md.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Claude
Message:
Add SlimAD\IndexNow Composer package skeleton

Framework-agnostic IndexNow client + queue. Submitting URLs goes through
IndexNowService into a UrlStore; SubmitJob drains it and pushes to every
configured search engine over PSR-18. URLs are kept in the store on partial
failure so the next cron tick retries.

Targets PHP 8.1+, PHPStan level 9 with strict rules, full unit test
coverage, and Infection-ready configuration.
